abstract: _early holocene ice retreat pattern of the laurentide le sheet in the laurentales deiatel man connu. a eest, la moraine marisbatiscan constitue la seule position frontale continue identifiee entre la moraine de saintnarcisse et la moraine de sakami_, comme la ceinture morainique de cartier 1, en ontario, la moraine marisbatiscan est montau de saintnarcisse a la la flui pisticoene. le territiore a letude est un transect, du saintnature au temsicamique, qui fait la fonction entre la moraine marisbatiscan et la peistocene. the study area is a transect between the riviere saintmaurice and the temsicamique area, roughly in the axis of the marsbatiscan and carrier morines. the application pattern of this transect is based on a systematic mapping of glacial landforms by air photography analysis at a scale of 1:15 840, verified by fieldwork. the glacial margin is bent east of the transect, it becomes relatively linear westward with a wswene general orientation and several minor locations and reentrants. the glacial margin was mainly controlled by topography. depalcation between the latitudinal margins of the transect occurred over a period of 600 years, approximately between 11.46 and 10,86 cal ka (10 000 and 9580 as c bp). an acceleration of the ice retreat rate occurred after the marsbatiscan moraine phase, followed by relatively stable rates of retreat. the new isochrones improve the previous models of demgication de la region mattawantemsicamique, puisquil montre un front de deglaciation lineaire et sans rentrant notable with no visible reentrant in the axis of the ottawa rivertemsicamique area during the studied time span._ 2003577892049692003578920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496204920496204920496920492049692049692049204969204
